definitions.label: Lichtblick WebUI
definitions.description: The Lichtblick browser server of one Run. It builds its initial layout from one high-level view input on stdin, serves the viewer pages, proxies the live-data WebSocket and hosts xgc2.lichtblick.v1 (describe, health and the in-memory desired view) on a Unix socket in the private runtime directory its owner allocated. Core alone owns Storage; pages persist UI documents through Core under the user's browser session.

socketPath.description: Absolute path of the control socket, inside a private runtime directory allocated by the process owner.

bridgePort.description: Foxglove-compatible WebSocket port on the local host

port.description: Lichtblick HTTP port on the local host; XGC uses the dedicated loopback port 18081

viewInputJson.description: One high-level view input JSON object on stdin (at most 8 MiB): layoutMode, runMode, optional worldBoundary and camera, frozen visualizationTopics and RobotFact rows, and optional viewer parameters. simpleLidarVisible is a boolean (default true) controlling builtin lidar visibility only. Accepted parameter names include historyVisible, historyShowPoseAxes, historyMaxRateHz, historyLineWidth, predictionShowPoseAxes, predictionMaxRateHz and predictionLineWidth. Prediction topics are laid out on /xgc/display plus the original topic.
